13: type ReadAU = AtomicUpdate<FlagToken, Commit<FlagToken>, ReadPred>;
14: type FlipAU = AtomicUpdate<FlagToken, Commit<FlagToken>, FlipPred>;
15: 
16: pub enum Protocol {
17:     Empty(GhostVarAuth<Option<FlipAU>>),
18:     Offering(Tracked<FlipAU>),
19:     Accepted,
20: }
21: 
22: use Protocol::*;
23: 
24: impl Protocol {
25:     proof fn take_empty(tracked self) -> (tracked out: GhostVarAuth<Option<FlipAU>>)
26:         requires self is Empty,
27:         ensures self == Empty(out),
28:     {
29:         match self {
30:             Empty(gva) => gva,
31:             _ => proof_from_false(),
32:         }
33:     }

35:     proof fn take_offer(tracked self) -> (tracked out: Tracked<FlipAU>)
36:         requires self is Offering,
37:         ensures self == Offering(out),

40:             Offering(au) => au,
41:             _ => proof_from_false(),

43:     }

47: type V = (PermissionBool, PermissionU32, GhostVarAuth<bool>, GhostVar<Option<FlipAU>>, Protocol);

49: pub struct FlagInv;
50: pub open spec const FLAG_INV: int = 2;
51: impl InvariantPredicate<K, V> for FlagInv {
52:     open spec fn inv(k: K, v: V) -> bool {
53:         let (value_id, pend_id, state_id, gv_id) = k;
54:         let (value_perm, pend_perm, state, gv, proto) = v;
55:         &&& value_perm.id() == value_id
56:         &&& pend_perm.id() == pend_id
57:         &&& state.id() == state_id
58:         &&& gv.id() == gv_id
59:         &&& state@ == value_perm.value()
60:         &&& pend_perm.value() < 3
61:         &&& match proto {
62:             Empty(gva) => {
63:                 &&& pend_perm.value() == 0
64:                 &&& gva.id() == gv_id
65:                 &&& gv@ is None
66:                 &&& gva@ is None
67:                 &&& gv@ == gva@
68:             }
69:             Offering(au) => {
70:                 &&& pend_perm.value() == 1
71:                 &&& gv@ is Some
72:                 &&& gv@->0 == au@
73:             },
74:             Accepted => {
75:                 &&& pend_perm.value() == 2
76:                 &&& gv@ is Some
77:                 &&& gv@->0.resolves()
78:             }
79:         }
80:     }
81: }

83: pub struct FlagToken {
84:     pub value: GhostVar<bool>,
85: }
86: 
87: impl FlagToken {

91: }
92: 
93: pub struct Flag {
94:     pub value: PAtomicBool,
95:     pub pending: PAtomicU32,
96:     pub inv: Tracked<AtomicInvariant<K, V, FlagInv>>,
97: }
98: 
99: impl Flag {
100:     pub open spec fn wf(self) -> bool {
101:         &&& self.inv@.constant().0 == self.value.id()
102:         &&& self.inv@.constant().1 == self.pending.id()
103:         &&& self.inv@.namespace() == FLAG_INV
104:     }
105: 
106:     pub open spec fn token_id(self) -> Loc {
107:         self.inv@.constant().2
108:     }
109: 
110:     pub fn new(init: bool) -> (out: (Self, Tracked<FlagToken>))
111:         ensures
112:             out.0.wf(),
113:             out.0.token_id() == out.1@.id(),
114:             out.1@.value@ == init,
115:     {
116:         let (value, Tracked(value_perm)) = PAtomicBool::new(init);
117:         let (pending, Tracked(pending_perm)) = PAtomicU32::new(0);
118:         let tracked (state_auth, state_var) = GhostVarAuth::new(init);
119:         let tracked (au_auth, au_var) = GhostVarAuth::new(None);
120:         let tracked inv = AtomicInvariant::new(
121:             (value.id(), pending.id(), state_auth.id(), au_auth.id()),
122:             (value_perm, pending_perm, state_auth, au_var, Empty(au_auth)),
123:             FLAG_INV,
124:         );
125: 
126:         let this = Self { value, pending, inv: Tracked(inv) };
127:         let tracked token = FlagToken { value: state_var };
128:         (this, Tracked(token))
129:     }
130: 
131:     pub fn read(&self) -> (out: bool)
132:         atomically (atomic_update) {
133:             type ReadPred,
134:             (old_token: FlagToken) -> (new_token: Commit<FlagToken>),
135:             requires
136:                 old_token.id() == self.token_id(),
137:             ensures
138:                 new_token@ == old_token,
139: 
140:             outer_mask ISet::<int>::full().remove(FLAG_INV),
141:             inner_mask none,
142:         },
143:         requires self.wf(),
144:         ensures out == old_token.value@,
145:     {
146:         let out;
147:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
148:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
149:             out = self.value.load(Tracked(&value_perm));
150: 
151:             proof {
152:                 try_open_atomic_update!(atomic_update, token=> {
153:                     auth.agree(&token.value);
154:                     assert(value_perm.value() == token.value@);
155:                     Tracked(Commit(token))
156:                 });
157: 
158:                 v = (value_perm, pend_perm, auth, gv, proto);
159:             }
160:         });
161: 
162:         return out;
163:     }
164: 
165:     pub fn flip(&self)
166:         atomically (atomic_update) {
167:             type FlipPred,
168:             (old_token: FlagToken) -> (new_token: Commit<FlagToken>),
169:             requires
170:                 old_token.id() == self.token_id(),
171:             ensures
172:                 new_token@.value@ == !old_token.value@,
173:                 new_token@.id() == old_token.id(),
174: 
175:             outer_mask any / [FLAG_INV],
176:             inner_mask none,
177:         },
178:         requires self.wf(),
179:     {
180:         let tracked mut au = atomic_update;
181: 
182:         loop invariant
183:             self.wf(),
184:             au == atomic_update,
185:         {
186:             match self.try_cancel_two_flips(Tracked(au)) {
187:                 Some(upd) => proof { au = upd.get() },
188:                 None => return,
189:             }
190: 
191:             match self.try_simple_flip(Tracked(au)) {
192:                 Some(upd) => proof { au = upd.get() },
193:                 None => return,
194:             }
195: 
196:             match self.try_handshake(Tracked(au)) {
197:                 Some(upd) => proof { au = upd.get() },
198:                 None => return,
199:             }
200:         }
201:     }
202: 
203:     fn try_cancel_two_flips(&self, Tracked(au): Tracked<FlipAU>) -> (out: Option<Tracked<FlipAU>>)
204:         requires
205:             self.wf(),
206:             au.pred().args(self),
207:         ensures
208:             match out {
209:                 Some(ret_au) => ret_au == au,
210:                 None => au.resolves(),
211:             }
212:     {
213:         let tracked mut maybe_au = Some(au);
214:         let res;
215: 
216:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
217:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
218:             res = self.pending.compare_exchange(Tracked(&mut pend_perm), 1, 2);
219: 
220:             proof {
221:                 if res.is_ok() {
222:                     let tracked au = maybe_au.tracked_take();
223:                     let tracked other_au = proto.take_offer();
224: 
225:                     assert(gv@ is Some);
226:                     assert(gv@->0 == other_au);
227: 
228:                     try_open_atomic_update!(au, mut token => {
229:                         let ghost old_auth = auth@;
230:                         auth.update(&mut token.value, !old_auth);
231:                         Tracked(Commit(token))
232:                     });
233: 
234:                     try_open_atomic_update!(other_au.get(), mut token => {
235:                         let ghost old_auth = auth@;
236:                         auth.update(&mut token.value, !old_auth);
237:                         Tracked(Commit(token))
238:                     });
239: 
240:                     assert(gv@ is Some);
241:                     assert(gv@->0.resolves());
242: 
243:                     proto = Accepted;
244:                 }
245: 
246:                 v = (value_perm, pend_perm, auth, gv, proto);
247:             }
248:         });
249: 
250:         if res.is_ok() {
251:             return None;
252:         }
253: 
254:         Some(Tracked(maybe_au.tracked_take()))
255:     }
256: 
257:     fn try_simple_flip(&self, Tracked(au): Tracked<FlipAU>) -> (out: Option<Tracked<FlipAU>>)
258:         requires
259:             self.wf(),
260:             au.pred().args(self),
261:         ensures
262:             match out {
263:                 Some(ret_au) => ret_au == au,
264:                 None => au.resolves(),
265:             }
266:     {
267:         let tracked mut maybe_au = Some(au);
268:         let res;
269: 
270:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
271:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
272:             res = self.value.compare_exchange(Tracked(&mut value_perm), true, false);
273:             proof {
274:                 if res.is_ok() {
275:                     let tracked au = maybe_au.tracked_take();
276:                     try_open_atomic_update!(au, mut token => {
277:                         let ghost old_auth = auth@;
278:                         auth.update(&mut token.value, !old_auth);
279:                         Tracked(Commit(token))
280:                     });
281:                 }
282: 
283:                 v = (value_perm, pend_perm, auth, gv, proto);
284:             }
285:         });
286: 
287:         if res.is_ok() {
288:             return None;
289:         }
290: 
291:         let res;
292: 
293:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
294:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
295:             res = self.value.compare_exchange(Tracked(&mut value_perm), false, true);
296:             proof {
297:                 if res.is_ok() {
298:                     let tracked au = maybe_au.tracked_take();
299:                     try_open_atomic_update!(au, mut token => {
300:                         let ghost old_auth = auth@;
301:                         auth.update(&mut token.value, !old_auth);
302:                         Tracked(Commit(token))
303:                     });
304:                 }
305: 
306:                 v = (value_perm, pend_perm, auth, gv, proto);
307:             }
308:         });
309: 
310:         if res.is_ok() {
311:             return None;
312:         }
313: 
314:         Some(Tracked(maybe_au.tracked_take()))
315:     }
316: 
317:     fn try_handshake(&self, Tracked(au): Tracked<FlipAU>) -> (out: Option<Tracked<FlipAU>>)
318:         requires
319:             self.wf(),
320:             au.pred().args(self),
321:         ensures
322:             match out {
323:                 Some(ret_au) => ret_au == au,
324:                 None => au.resolves(),
325:             }
326:     {
327:         let tracked mut maybe_au = Some(au);
328:         let tracked mut auth_au: Option<GhostVarAuth<Option<FlipAU>>> = None;
329:         let res;
330: 
331:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
332:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
333:             res = self.pending.compare_exchange(Tracked(&mut pend_perm), 0, 1);
334: 
335:             proof {
336:                 v = (value_perm, pend_perm, auth, gv, proto);
337:             }
338:         });
339: 
340:         if res.is_err() {
341:             return Some(Tracked(maybe_au.tracked_take()));
342:         }
343: 
344:         assert(auth_au is Some);
345: 
346:         let res;
347: 
348:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => v => {
349:             let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;
350:             res = self.pending.compare_exchange(Tracked(&mut pend_perm), 1, 0);

354:             }
355:         });

359:                 let tracked (mut value_perm, mut pend_perm, mut auth, mut gv, mut proto) = v;

    lynette_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent/ "lynette" / "source"

    def run(self, command):
        command = self.meta_command + command
        return subprocess.run(command, env=self.env, capture_output=True, text=True)
